Interesting video, but it doesn't even mention the legal side of things that most people don't seem to know about: that you have far more ownership rights, sale, trade, and gifting rights than you do with digital media. Which is one reason so many companies are trying to move to digital distribution, you don't have the same legally protected rights to do what you want with that content, including selling and trading, ownership, and after death retention of those digital goods (meaning that it can't be passed on to your children or other beneficiary). The push for cloud computing has far more behind it than just convenience, ease of distribution, and information gathering. Which is one of the reasons that digital game distribution is seeing double digit growth even as the industry bitches about piracy hurting them.
